item.title: github: GitHub package firewall in public preview
item.description:
GitHub package firewall is now in public preview. It is intended to reduce malware risks during package installation by blocking package-install-time attacks that can steal credentials from CI/CD hosts or developer workstations.

  • Source: GitHub
